name: Trinbago Knight Riders
profile_lede: The competition's most successful franchise begins its title defence with a decorated Trinidad and Tobago core and five matches at Tarouba.
history: The franchise entered the inaugural CPL season in 2013 as Trinidad & Tobago Red Steel, won its first title in 2015 and adopted the Trinbago Knight Riders name in 2016.
Further championships followed in 2017, 2018 and an unbeaten 2020 campaign. A fifth CPL crown in 2025 made TKR the tournament's most successful team and sends them into 2026 as defending champions.
Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein headline a highly experienced local group. Brian Lara Cricket Academy hosts five TKR fixtures from 26 August to 2 September.

summary: The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title.
storyline: Trinbago's five-match home block at Brian Lara Cricket Academy runs from 26 August to 2 September before the league-stage finish in Guyana.
